account_link_kind_coherente.name: account_link_kind_coherente
account_link_kind_coherente.value:
("account_link"."kind" = 'alumno' and "account_link"."contact_id" is not null and "account_link"."teacher_id" is null)
       or ("account_link"."kind" = 'profesor' and "account_link"."teacher_id" is not null and "account_link"."contact_id" is null)

assessment_min_score_by_scale.name: assessment_min_score_by_scale
assessment_min_score_by_scale.value: ("assessment"."scale" = 'pass_fail' and "assessment"."min_score" is null) or ("assessment"."scale" = 'numeric' and "assessment"."min_score" between 1 and 100)

company_payment_term_days_valid.name: company_payment_term_days_valid
company_payment_term_days_valid.value: "company"."payment_term_days" IS NULL OR ("company"."payment_terms" = 'credito' AND "company"."payment_term_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 365)

contact_activity_note_has_body.name: contact_activity_note_has_body
contact_activity_note_has_body.value: "contact_activity"."kind" <> 'nota' OR ("contact_activity"."body" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("contact_activity"."body")) > 0)

course_assessment_template_min_score_by_.name: course_assessment_template_min_score_by_scale
course_assessment_template_min_score_by_.value: ("course_assessment_template"."scale" = 'pass_fail' and "course_assessment_template"."min_score" is null) or ("course_assessment_template"."scale" = 'numeric' and "course_assessment_template"."min_score" between 1 and 100)

offline_course_access_target_coherent.name: offline_course_access_target_coherent
offline_course_access_target_coherent.value:
("offline_course_access"."cohort_id" is not null and "offline_course_access"."enrollment_id" is null and "offline_course_access"."mode" is null)
       or ("offline_course_access"."enrollment_id" is not null and "offline_course_access"."cohort_id" is null and "offline_course_access"."mode" is not null)

offline_course_grant_revocacion_coherent.name: offline_course_grant_revocacion_coherente
offline_course_grant_revocacion_coherent.value: "offline_course_grant"."revoked_by" is null or "offline_course_grant"."revoked_at" is not null

offline_recognition_course_active_uq.name: offline_recognition_course_active_uq
offline_recognition_course_active_uq.where: lesson_id is null and revoked_at is null

offline_recognition_lesson_active_uq.name: offline_recognition_lesson_active_uq
offline_recognition_lesson_active_uq.where: lesson_id is not null and revoked_at is null

resource_contenedor_unico.name: resource_contenedor_unico
resource_contenedor_unico.value:
(case when "resource"."course_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
        + (case when "resource"."cohort_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
        + (case when "resource"."class_session_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
        + (case when "resource"."assessment_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end)
        + (case when "resource"."course_assessment_template_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end) = 1

staff_notice_subject_valid.name: staff_notice_subject_valid
staff_notice_subject_valid.value:
("staff_notice"."kind" IN ('cohorte_confirmada','facturacion_t7','facturacion_t2','sin_confirmar_t7','sin_confirmar_t2','sin_confirmar_inicio') AND "staff_notice"."cohort_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("staff_notice"."kind" = 'inscripcion_nueva' AND "staff_notice"."enrollment_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("staff_notice"."kind" = 'pago_registrado' AND "staff_notice"."enrollment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "staff_notice"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("staff_notice"."kind" = 'morosidad_semanal' AND "staff_notice"."period_key" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("staff_notice"."kind" = 'interesado_nuevo' AND "staff_notice"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL)

submission_abierta_uq.name: submission_abierta_uq
submission_abierta_uq.where: corrected_at is null and reopened_at is null

virtual_room_zoom_user_uq.name: virtual_room_zoom_user_uq
virtual_room_zoom_user_uq.where: "virtual_room"."zoom_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "virtual_room"."archived_at" IS NULL
